by_category:
def by_category (s : State) : List (String × Int) :=
  s.expenses.foldl cat_add []
cat_add:
def cat_add (acc : List (String × Int)) (e : Expense) : List (String × Int) :=
  match acc with
  | [] => [(e.category, e.cents)]
  | p :: t => if p.1 = e.category then (p.1, p.2 + e.cents) :: t else p :: cat_add t e
total:
def total (s : State) : Int :=
  sum_cents s.expenses
